key_insight: The paper shows that zero-noise extrapolation can be adapted to indirect-control VQE by leveraging symmetry in a 1D XY spin chain, despite the difficulty of defining inverse operations for time-evolution-based circuits.
engineering_relevance: This extends error mitigation to a more hardware-efficient quantum control model, helping reduce control-channel complexity while preserving practical access to near-term quantum simulation.
method: Analyze how ZNE can work when gates are replaced by continuous Hamiltonian evolution
Address the unitary-folding challenge under indirect-control constraints
Use a minimal relaxation of the control restriction plus XY-chain symmetry to construct a physically realizable mitigation strategy
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates a feasibility study focused on adapting ZNE to indirect-control VQE and on resolving the implementation barriers posed by time-evolution operators.
watch_item: The approach depends on a minimal relaxation of the indirect-control constraint and may be specific to the symmetry structure of the one-dimensional XY model.
paper_title: Error Mitigation by Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE) in Indirect-Control System
